description: This file contains functions and classes for loading and managing sharded optimizer state dictionaries in a distributed training context, specifically for FSDP (Fully Sharded Data Parallel) in PyTorch. It includes utilities for tensor allocation, layout computation, and state dict reconstruction from checkpoint metadata.

classes.name: _ReaderWithOffset
classes.description: A custom load planner class that manages reading tensor chunks with specific offsets, used for loading sharded optimizer states.

methods.name: _gen_rank_device
methods.description: Generates a device string ('cpu' or 'cuda') based on the global rank and device type.

methods.name: _create_colwise_spec
methods.description: Creates a ChunkShardingSpec with column-wise sharding based on the process group.

methods.name: _is_nested_tensor
methods.description: Checks if a tensor is a nested ShardedTensor or DTensor, raising errors if nested DTensors are encountered.

methods.name: _alloc_tensor
methods.description: Allocates an uninitialized tensor with specified properties, size, and device type.

methods.name: _get_state_dict_2d_layout
methods.description: Determines the 2D layout (offsets and sizes) for each tensor in the optimizer state dict, used for sharded loading.

methods.name: load_sharded_optimizer_state_dict
methods.description: Loads a sharded optimizer state dict from checkpoint metadata, reconstructing tensors and sharded tensors accordingly.
